text:
Mia (Support): Customer CareFlow filed a P1 asking for streaming completions that emit incremental fncall events to their webhook plus a final validated JSON. They want partial events so downstream can start work early.

Andre (Sales): They quoted 300 qps bursts, 30 rps steady. Need <250ms per chunk and a beta SLA to close.

Ravi (Product): Quick clarifiers: webhook only or websocket ok? resumable resume_token? server validation and a final reconcile event?

Mia (Support): Webhook preferred. They want resume_token to resume after disconnect and a final "final_output" event. Server-side schema validation required.

Tess (Eng): Feasibility: we stream tokens + final fncall now. For partial fncall events we need framed events (fncall.start/update/finish), resume tokens, idempotency on replay. Rough: 2w spec + 4w build + 1w SDK/docs + canary. Risks: replay duplication and webhook backpressure.

Nia (SRE): We'll need webhook retries/backoff, idempotency keys, and DLQ. Also per-request tracing for billing.

Ravi (Product): Proposed beta scope: webhook-only, single model family, PII redaction opt-in, signed webhooks, Python/TS SDK helpers. Beta target: 6 weeks. Owner: @Tess. ops-bot: create ticket.

ops-bot: Created INF-5120 and assigned to Tess.

Tess (Eng): I'll draft RFC with event schema and resume semantics. Example event idea:
```
POST /webhook/careflow
{ "event":"fncall.update", "request_id":"rq_01", "call_id":"c1", "delta":{"op":"append","path":"items","value":{"id":42}}, "resume_token":"rt_9" }
```
